title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 072
review_goal: Differentiate mic, mountain, and news variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Classic microphone capsule above one curved stand frame and one lower stem
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic upright microphone with a curved stand frame beneath it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the grille microphone when horizontal grille bars should appear inside the head.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows an oval microphone capsule on a curved stand with one short lower stem.

items.depicts_observation: Broadcast microphone capsule with four grille bars above one lower stand stem
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a broadcast microphone with visible grille bars inside the head.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain capsule microphone when the head should stay smooth and unlined.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds horizontal grille bars inside a rectangular microphone capsule.

items.depicts_observation: Single mountain peak with one centered snowcap above a flat ground line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants one mountain peak with a snowcap centered near the top.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the double mountain icon when a second rear peak should appear at the right.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one main peak with one snowcap and no second mountain behind it.

items.depicts_observation: Two mountain peaks with one front snowcap and one smaller right peak
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a front mountain peak paired with a second smaller peak on the right.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single mountain when only one peak should dominate the icon.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second smaller peak behind the main snowcapped mountain.

items.depicts_observation: Front page sheet with two centered text bars and one right side spine
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a front page sheet with a visible right side spine attached.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stacked news sheets when a second page should appear behind the front page.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one main page face with two bars and a side spine on the right.
